content.short: CryptoChill is a scalable crypto payment gateway for TON, TON Jettons, BTC, ETH, TRON, and more.
content.description: CryptoChill is a crypto payment gateway focused on flexible merchant payment flows. TON App listings describe support for TON, TON Jettons, BTC, ETH, TRON, and other assets, with TON wallet infrastructure for efficient fees and high-load wallets for batched payouts. The product is aimed at teams that need invoices, conversions, funding rules, and withdrawals in an automated payment stack. CryptoChill belongs with wallets because the main job is custody, account access, transfers, signing, dapp connection, or asset management.
